clean.tl: I will give you to a devil, who will devour you!

clean.tx: Rasiku mo sle naruna isan Pira nohoni.

clean.tx: Nanovi, nam ulia leta mo sivo san puá.
clean.tl: Yesterday, I wrote a letter to my mother.
